[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:388YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Rhisiart Heartsbane, Senator for Miaren, Seconded: Bronimir Ranedzkah Pinewheel, Senator for Ossium">To commission the restoration of the Botanical Gardens at the First Voice Glade School in Miaren. Self-funded, raised to the benefit of all who seek to study with the Navarr as masters of herb-lore. The restoration of the gardens will empower the Dean of the First Voice Glade to upgrade a member of the Vallornguard's herb garden without cost each summit, strengthening prosperity and the health of the Empire
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Oakways, Miaren
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 30 wains of weirwood
* 90 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Botanical_Gardens_of_First_Voice_Glade}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the botanical gardens will have the following effects:
*The [[Dean of the First Voice Glade]] will once again receive 27 drams of herbs each season.
*The Dean of the First Voice Glade will be able to upgrade a single basic [[herb garden]] belonging to a member of the [[Vallornguard]] each season
